Fresh · Local · Homemade

Café menu.

Tea on the veranda, cold drinks after a trek, and hot pakoras when the mist comes down. Served through the day at the farm kitchen.

Home / Stay / Menu

Your room rate already includes three Garhwali meals a day — breakfast, lunch and dinner, cooked from Geeta's family recipes on spring water. Everything below is the café menu: teas, cold drinks and snacks available through the day, charged separately.
